name: Deck of Many Things
description: The 22-card Deck of Many Things, paraphrased from the System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

entities.name: Deck of Many Things
entities.description: Before drawing, a player says how many cards they will draw, then draws them one at a time; each card takes effect as soon as it is drawn. If they stop before drawing them all, the rest fly from the deck on their own and take effect at once. Except for the Fool and the Jester, a drawn card returns to the deck: the gamemaster shuffles the discard pile back in.

cards.name: Balance
cards.text: Your alignment flips: lawful and chaotic swap, and so do good and evil. A true neutral or unaligned character is unaffected.

cards.name: Comet
cards.text: If you defeat the next hostile monster or group of monsters you meet entirely on your own, you gain enough experience to go up one level. Otherwise nothing happens.

cards.name: Donjon
cards.text: You vanish, held in suspended animation inside an extradimensional sphere. Everything you wore and carried stays behind. Divination cannot find you, but a wish reveals where you are. You draw no more cards.

cards.name: Euryale
cards.text: A medusa-like curse falls on you: -2 to saving throws. Only a god or the magic of the Fates card can lift it.

cards.name: Fates
cards.text: Reality is rewoven: you may undo one event as if it never happened. Use it right away or keep it until you die.

cards.name: Flames
cards.text: A powerful devil becomes your enemy. It works to ruin you and enjoys your suffering before trying to kill you. The feud lasts until one of you dies.

cards.name: Fool
cards.text: You lose 10,000 XP, though never enough to lose a level. Discard this card and draw again; both draws count as one of your declared draws.

cards.name: Gem
cards.text: Twenty-five pieces of jewellery worth 2,000 gp each, or fifty gems worth 1,000 gp each, appear at your feet.

cards.name: Idiot
cards.text: Your Intelligence drops for good by 1d4 + 1, to no less than 1. You may draw one card more than you declared.

cards.name: Jester
cards.text: Gain 10,000 XP, or draw two cards more than you declared.

cards.name: Key
cards.text: A rare or rarer magic weapon you are proficient with appears in your hands. The gamemaster picks it.

cards.name: Knight
cards.text: A 4th-level fighter of your own people appears within 30 feet and serves you loyally until death, sure that fate brought you together.

cards.name: Moon
cards.text: You can cast wish 1d3 times.

cards.name: Rogue
cards.text: A nonplayer character of the gamemaster's choice turns against you in secret. Only a wish or divine help can end their hostility.

cards.name: Ruin
cards.text: You lose all your wealth except magic items. What you carry vanishes; buildings, land and businesses are lost in whatever way changes the world least.

cards.name: Skull
cards.text: An avatar of death appears within 10 feet and attacks you. You must fight it alone: anyone who helps summons an avatar of their own. Whoever an avatar kills cannot be brought back to life.

cards.name: Star
cards.text: Raise one ability score by 2, up to 24.

cards.name: Sun
cards.text: Gain 50,000 XP, and a wondrous item of the gamemaster's choice appears in your hands.

cards.name: Talons
cards.text: Every magic item you wear or carry crumbles to dust. Artifacts are not destroyed, but vanish.

cards.name: Throne
cards.text: You gain proficiency in Persuasion with double your proficiency bonus, and rightful ownership of a small keep. Monsters hold it now; clear them out to claim it.

cards.name: Vizier
cards.text: Once within a year, you may ask a question while meditating and receive a true answer, with the insight to use it well.

cards.name: The Void
cards.text: Your soul is taken and locked in an object somewhere of the gamemaster's choice, guarded by powerful beings, and your body is incapacitated. A wish cannot free you but shows where the object is. You draw no more cards.
